### When I Stray
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/when-i-stray-encouragement-for-today-jan-15-2013.html
Passage: Hosea 11:4
Points:
- Believers still stumble into sin, which often brings sharp feelings of shame and regret.
- Trying to bury guilt under busyness fails, whereas genuine relief comes through honest prayer.
- Rather than pulling wayward children back harshly, God gently draws them home with love.
- Experiencing the Lord's tender forgiveness motivates believers to extend gracious kindness to others.

### When I Need Some Help
Author: Amy Carroll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/when-i-need-some-help-encouragement-for-today-november-13-2015.html
Passage: Hosea 11:3-4
Points:
- Christian life requires ongoing spiritual maturation, much like an infant learning to walk.
- God never leaves His children to struggle alone, but actively supports and catches them.
- Stubborn self-reliance robs believers of the joy found in trusting God's direction.
- The Lord nurtures His people with fatherly tenderness, delighting in them despite their imperfect steps.
